hold.clamp: shop-made two-stud bridge tightened on the free foot, reacting through rear washers and nuts against the angle plate

clamps.note: bridge underside on the finished foot top; force +Y toward the seat/angle plate, two studs at Setup X +/-20 through the upright, rear nuts behind it; bar maximum Setup Z -9.65

hold.note: Seat the finished seat face against the angle-plate upright, outer face up and 2 mm proud of the plate top. Coordinates below are relative to this Setup's zero. Rest the foot free end on the bolted ledge at Z -24.2 to take the downward facing/drilling load. The bridge underside bears on the finished foot top at Y -6, centred at Z -16, and presses the foot toward the plate (+Y); two studs at X +/-20 pass through the upright, with rear washers touching the plate back and rear nuts behind it. Indicate the exposed 2 mm seat lip with a small-ball DTI above the plate, then tighten and recheck. Establish a preliminary paper-Z reference with the stationary edge-finder on the raw outer face (Z +1) before the side pickups. Pick up the left foot face at Y -3, Z -4, above the bridge; pick up the common plate front from -Y at X +45, Z -5, clear of the bridge hardware. Retract above Z +5 before traversing between pickups, then paper-zero the cutting tool as specified. The bridge bar reaches maximum Z -9.65; studs, washers and nuts stay outside the foot width, clear of the foot-end ledge/base, arch and cross-bore.
hold.stop: Rest the foot free end on the bolted plate ledge at Setup Z -24.2; align the finished left foot edge at Setup X -8 before clamping.
